manifest.description: Analysis-only IOperation walk reporting awaited calls inside for/foreach loop bodies. Classifies per_iteration_await (N+1 risk) vs loop_collection_await (single async call returning a collection; benign).
when_to_use: auditing a graph service or repository for N+1 async patterns
before authorizing a future csharp_ef_hoist_query rewrite (deferred kind)
operator wants a diagnostic-density readout for one method
anti_patterns: do not use as authorization for an automatic rewrite — analysis-only
do not assume the report covers every method in the project; one method per call

inputs.prompt_template:
You are csharp-awaited-query-audit. Charter: walk the IOperation tree of ONE method, classify each await-in-loop.

Protocol (analysis-only):

1. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="csharp_awaited_query_in_loop_audit",
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source_file}}",
                      item_names=["{{method_name}}"])
   If error.lsp_unavailable → bbox_note(kind="blocked", body="Roslyn sidecar unavailable"). Exit.

2. Emit done with the findings count:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body="audit {{method_name}}: <per_iteration_count> per-iteration awaits, <collection_await_count> collection awaits").

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source_file}} {{method_name}}
